_comment: Fast (30s) cross-talk check for the W18 IRQ fix: channel 1 and channel 3 - the two channels with motors actually mounted - are wired to SHARE PIO0 here (ch1 sm0/rx1, ch3 sm2/rx3; ch2 and ch4 pushed to sm4/sm6, idle) - exactly the 2-bidir-pairs-per-block configuration that was broken under the old literal irq(4) (both RX state machines waiting on the same block-wide flag). Held at deliberately DIFFERENT throttles so their eRPM streams should read clearly different if uncorrupted; if there's still cross-talk, expect CRC failures or one channel echoing the other's values. Not a stability test - no expect block.
